title: fix(spec): say what the dashboard `gap` author decides, not what the renderer consumes
body:
Fixes #14586

Prose only. No schema shape, no export, no accept set: `gap` stays `z.number().int().min(0).optional()`.

## The two producer strings

| # | producer | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts:25` `helpText` | `Grid gap (Tailwind units)` | `Space between widgets, in steps of 0.25rem (4 = 1rem)` |
| 2 | `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:903` `.describe()` and the JSDoc at `:902` | `Grid gap in Tailwind spacing units` | `Space between widgets, in steps of 0.25rem (4 = 1rem)` |

Site 1 renders in the Studio property panel. Site 2 renders as this field's row in `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx`. Fixing site 1 alone would have relocated the divergence rather than removed it — the panel saying what an author decides while the published reference page still named the library, invisible from either side. That is the same producer/consumer split this card exists to close.

## The control for site 2, re-run rather than inherited

The dispatch flagged that the whole widening rests on one control, so it was re-derived here. It reproduces, and a paired positive turns it from an absence into a measurement:

| control | expected | `grep -F` exit |
|---|---|---|
| `columns` **helpText** `Grid columns (default 12)` in the mdx | absent | 1 |
| `columns` **describe** `Number of grid columns (default 12)` in the mdx | present (line 35) | 0 |
| `gap` **helpText** `Grid gap (Tailwind units)` in the mdx | absent | 1 |
| `gap` **describe** `Grid gap in Tailwind spacing units` in the mdx | present (line 36) | 0 |

Generalized: **none** of the four dashboard `helpText` strings appears anywhere under `content/` (0 hits each). The reference corpus renders `.describe()`, never `helpText` — two independent producers, two independent published surfaces.

## Keeping the magnitude without naming the framework

The old strings carried a real fact: the value is a spacing step, so `4` means `1rem`, not `4px`. Dropping it with the framework name would have left an author knowing less than before.

The replacement states the step size, and states it **as measured rather than inferred**. The dashboard renderer does not emit a utility class for this key at all — it sets an inline style computed from it:

```
style={{ ..., gap: `${gap * 0.25}rem` }}
```

So one step is exactly `0.25rem`, every accepted integer is linear, and there are no gaps in the scale to mislead anyone. Two consequences worth recording:

- `Space between widgets, in steps of 0.25rem (4 = 1rem)` is exactly true for every value the schema accepts, and names only a CSS unit.
- **"Tailwind units" was doubly wrong.** It named an implementation dependency, and it named one the actual consumer of this key does not have.

## Scope held

⛔ No sweep. `columns` is untouched on both of its producer lines — `12` is an author-visible fact about the grid being laid out. No other framework-vocabulary site was searched for or changed. The only remaining occurrences of `Grid gap` in the tree are this PR's own changeset quoting the before-strings.

The diff is five paths; the three beyond the two producers are derived artifacts, regenerated by the repo's tooling and never hand-edited. Declared on the card in-round (comment 5545366885):

- `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx` — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`, which reported `gen:docs` as the one stale artifact of 15 and regenerated it.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` — `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. Not a scope choice: `dispatch-gates.mjs` names this gate for this change KIND, and it was measured red before the regeneration (`pnpm check:i18n` exit **1**, `platform-objects: 1 bundle(s) drifted`) and green after (exit **0**). `en` is a mechanical copy of the form source, never merged.

**No regeneration delta appeared outside `ui/dashboard.mdx`** — one file, one line. #14477 regenerates under `content/docs/references/system/**`; measured disjoint, and `main` has moved zero paths under `content/docs/references/` since this branch point.

## Changeset: `patch`, derived not assumed

`@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`, both `patch`.

Derived from the rule the guard's own header points at — the `WHICH LEVEL` prose in `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` (maintainer ruling 2026-09-04, decision batch 35, on #15294): *a purely additive widening of a published package's public surface (a new exported symbol on an index, a new accepted key or value) takes at least `minor`; a `fix(` that changes no public surface stays `patch`.* The discriminator is **widening**, and this widens nothing: no symbol, no key, no value, and the accept set is byte-for-byte the one it was. Prose is not a widening, so `patch`.

The `skip-changeset` label does **not** apply: the rule for it is "releases nothing", and this ships from two published packages. Precedent for prose-only changes in a published package grading `patch` is in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` (a `@objectstack/service-cluster` patch whose entire content is doc-comment corrections).

## Gates

All run at `765da3a98` — the final commit — with each exit code captured **before** any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`). Families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual 5-path change set, not from the dispatch's list.

**Green (exit 0), 48:** `api-surface` · `authorable-surface` · `browser-reachable-entries` · `changeset-gate-self-tests` · `corpus-claim-drift` · `cross-package-test-inputs` · `doc-anchors` · `doc-authoring` · `doc-formula-expressions` · `doc-security-posture` · `check:docs` · `docs-audit-scope` · `docs-redirects` · `docs-single-h1` · `dual-source-exports` · `empty-state` · `entry-nameability` · `export-origins` · `exported-any` · `check:generated` · `liveness` · `llms-txt` · `logger-receiver-detach` · `merge-driver` · `objectui-changeset` · `org-identifier` · `page-declaration-shape` · `published-files` · `published-readme-links` · `quick-reference-counts` · `react-page-adapter-contract` · `role-word` · `skill-examples` · `skill-identifier-liveness` · `skill-refs` · `slot-lookup` · `spec-parsed-alias` · `strictness-ledger` · `test-source-alias` · `type-source-resolution` · `variant-docs` · `vendor-version-stamps` · `widget-option-census` · `yaml-examples` · `driver-memory-census` · `nul-bytes` · `refd-timer-probe` · `watch-hint-literal`

Plus `check:i18n` 0 · `check:i18n-walk-parity` 0 · `check:i18n-stale-fill` 0 · `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` 0 · `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0.

**Tests and types:** `@objectstack/spec` vitest **471 files / 12657 tests passed**, exit 0. `@objectstack/spec` typecheck 0, `@objectstack/platform-objects` typecheck 0, platform-objects translations suite (7 files / 85 tests) 0, and the CLI's `i18n-extract-emitted-files` suite (4 tests) 0 — the two test files that import the regenerated bundle.

**Repo-wide lint:** `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit **0**, run whole rather than narrowed.

**NOT MEASURED — reported as such, not as passes:**

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — exit **3**, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: it reads built output and 11 packages have no `dist/`, requiring a whole-repo `pnpm build`. Its own words: *"This is NOT a pass: nothing was measured."* Left to CI, which builds the repo anyway. A prose-only diff cannot change a module's format or export shape.
- `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` — exit **3**, same class (a partial round cannot judge the ratchet). Not in this diff's derived families; run opportunistically.
- `check:react-declaration-parity` — cannot run in this repo at all; it needs objectui's browser-produced `sdui.manifest.json`.

`check:skill-examples` first returned exit 1 as a refusal (`client-react` had no `.d.ts`) rather than a finding; the prerequisite was built and it then reported **257 prose examples type-checking across 3 surfaces**, exit 0.

## Follow-ups filed, not ridden along

- **objectstack-ai/objectui#7673** — the cross-repo card triage flagged. The zh overlay from objectui#7366 now translates a sentence the spec no longer says, and its citation comment quotes the retired literal verbatim. Carries `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#14586` and both exact before/after strings. Measured for the objectui seat: the two have **converged on intent** but **not on content** — the new English carries the magnitude, the overlay carries only a direction — so "delete the overlay" is available but costs information. Duplicate-searched first (900 rows, open and closed); objectui#7369 is related, not duplicate.
- **#15511** — the zh-CN half in this repo. `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts:935` still reads 「栅格间距（Tailwind 单位）」, and regeneration provably will not fix it: merge fills gaps only, so `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` are both **green over the stale leaf**. Not fixed here because the dispatch forbade sweeping and because the replacement is a Chinese wording judgement that objectui#7369 will likely inherit. Worth noting for triage: #14587 swept this exact subtree on 2026-09-03 and correctly left `gap` alone because it was accurate then — so this is a leaf a landed source edit turns stale with every instrument green, which is the mechanism #14931 says nothing here can judge.

## Landing

Draft, as dispatched. ⛔ I have not flipped it ready, enqueued it, or armed auto-merge — that is the seat's, after review. Clause ② is **no**, carried on the card's governing claim comment in the bare machine spelling.
